description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I (Bartz - Water)], [Spellblade Resonance +5% Boost] and [Instant Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I (Bartz - Water)
description.text: Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Spellblade Dance: Water after using equipped Spellblade abilities (max 2)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Cast time x999999 for Spellblade abilities, grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II (Bartz - Water)], removes [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I (Bartz - Water)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II (Bartz - Water)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, critical chance =100%, casts Dual Waterblade after using Spellblade abilities (max 2)

description.name: Dual Waterblade
description.text: One single attack (2.64) capped at 99999 100% hit rate, grants [Dualcast Spellblade 1] to the user/all allies if 0-3/4+ allies with Job Synergy are alive

description.name: Spellblade Dance: Water
description.text: One single attack (3.36) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3
